verdict.rationale: The official Fivetran MCP server supports a `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` env var that restricts an agent to read-only vs read/write vs read/write/delete operations, which is a concrete least-privilege scoping mechanism for agent-facing API access (fivetran-docs-28, fivetran-docs-29, fivetran-docs-60). Broader account-level RBAC also exists but isn't tied specifically to issuing scoped credentials for agents. Missing for 10: documentation on generating distinct API key/secret pairs with fine-grained scopes for individual agents, and independent confirmation that the MCP scope mechanism is robust/secure in practice.
